item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. You've got training and a walk on today's schedule, plus an evening wind-down — all of that runs better on real fuel, not skipped meals or mindless grazing. Notice whether you're eating from hunger or just habit, especially in the busier stretches of the day. Dinner's already on the calendar — treat it as a proper sit-down, not something rushed. One action: before your next meal, pause and ask if you're actually hungry.
